changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.39[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Next episode and end credits[/COLOR]
-New: "Play the next episode on its own, without the window" (Settings > TV Shows > Continuous Episode Playback). The episode plays to the end and the next one starts by itself a few seconds before it finishes. Help is next to the setting.
-New: "Skip the end credits (Skip Outro)" (Settings > TV Shows > Skip Intro), with TheIntroDB's credits times. When a scene follows the credits, the credits are skipped and the scene plays. With "Play the next episode on its own" also on, the next episode starts as soon as the credits begin. It follows "Auto-skip silently": on, it skips by itself; off, a "Skip Credits" button shows. Help is next to the setting.
[COLOR fffdb515]Kodi shutdown[/COLOR]
-Fixed: the add-on's background service no longer keeps Kodi waiting when it closes ("script didn't stop in 5 seconds"). kodi.log now names any task still busy at that moment and says how long the stop took.
-Fixed: with Settings > Library > "Auto Update Service" on, the library check no longer keeps the processor busy in the hours between two runs, and an error there no longer repeats in a loop.
-Fixed: searching for sources, playing and adding to the library now stop at once when Kodi closes, instead of carrying on.
[COLOR fffdb515]Play an NZB[/COLOR]
-Fixed: an NZB with a scrambled name sometimes got no title card: a random name can look like an episode number, and the film was then looked up as a TV show. The episode now comes from the name of the video inside.
[COLOR fffdb515]Under the hood[/COLOR]
-Errors in sources, playback, library and the Movies and TV Shows menus are caught the standard way, so they no longer hide Kodi's shutdown request.
-The language folders now use Kodi's current names (resource.language.en_gb and resource.language.es_es). Nothing changes on screen.
